about: E106: every talking setup a build may use, with its direct 0-credit Pavo probe (SYSTEM.md 'No rework'). A setup is the speaker, the reference images its request sends for the speaker (record id -> sha256) and the prompt binding (episode_build.BOUND_AUDIO); preflight.setup_key builds it from the plan and refuses a talking shot whose setup is not here (PROBE_REQUIRED). generations / passed: lipsync_check passes over direct Pavo calls on that setup with the plan's pose (thresholds unchanged). A new speaker, a new speaking frame or a new binding is a new entry, added by PR with its evidence file.

setups.speaker: keeper
setups.binding: speaks the words of the audio clip, {pronoun} lips moving in sync with the voice
setups.pose: static camera, looks straight into the camera (plan_check.KEEPER_POSE)
setups.note: the 8 direct calls on storyteller-ref.jpg with the E95 binding (camera-facing static 2 of 4, cropped reference 1 of 3, run prompt 0 of 1); E98 plans on about 4 in 10. The lips check still fails often (genesis-07 k-insight): PR #419 measures more.
